name: Metroid Prime Origins
storyline: All of the in-game lore has been re-written; based on the original NTSC lore.
summary:
A fully complete adaptation of Metroid Prime for the Game Cube in 2D, complimented by a fake-bit aesthetic. This has been lovely to work on, and I had a lovely team of fellow fans by my side this entire time.

This game was made with no generative AI. All sprites and music were created by fans, and all of the in-game lore has been re-written; based on the original NTSC lore.
